summary: Completed backend + frontend regression for multiple-payments and owner+tenant CC email flows. Added persistent backend regression tests for 8 payment scenarios, validation, receipt stability, migration idempotency, backup v4 payment dedupe, and FK cascade. Full backend suite passed: 42 passed, 3 skipped in runtime (aiosmtpd not installed there), plus skipped SMTP loopback tests passed separately in local test venv (3/3) using loopback receiver. Frontend desktop/mobile checks passed for payment create/edit/delete, remaining-balance validation, route coverage (billing/food/payments/overdue/reports/import/backup/tenants), tenant autocomplete, and no mobile overflow on 390px.
action_items: Optional hardening: add explicit concurrent overpayment stress test (threaded/multiprocess) against live API if required by release gate.
Optional consistency update: align route naming references in docs/tests to actual app routes (/billing, /food, /import).
critical_code_review_comments: Payment API correctly blocks overpayment and preserves immutable original invoice total/invoice number after payment CRUD.
Receipt identity (receiptNumber) remains stable on payment edit; receipt totals recompute from ledger state as expected.
PUT /api/payments/{id} does not permit invoice reassignment (invoiceId ignored by schema), preserving relational integrity.
Backup JSON v4 merge keeps payment records deduplicated by IDs and does not duplicate on repeated merge imports.
SMTP local receiver coverage is REAL (loopback aiosmtpd), not Gmail; one MIME message behavior and To/CC envelope behavior validated.
seed_data_creation: Created one UI test invoice tenant TEST_UI_PAY_750256 on preview DB; payment create/edit/delete executed and ended with no payments on that invoice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Runtime backend env still lacks aiosmtpd, so 3 SMTP loopback tests skip there by design; they were executed successfully in /root/shpg-mail-test-venv. New regression file test_payments_regression.py reuses backend_test hermetic client to avoid DB_PATH cross-module interference under xdist.
rca of the issue: Initial full-suite failure after adding new tests was caused by DB_PATH side-effects from module-level environment mutation in the new test file. Fixed by reusing backend_test's shared hermetic TestClient instead of overriding DB_PATH in a second module.
